integrity: The equations, equilibrium levels, and primary differential-equations classification were checked against a mathematical preprint on the same system. A full open-access integrability article on the same model was inspected through its system description, recurrent-dynamics discussion, invariant-measure discussion, and analytical sections. The new generator identities and equality cases were independently reconstructed and the polynomial algebra was replayed from the packaged exact checker. No numerical simulation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures for positive parameters.
The zero-parameter Nosé-Hoover limit is outside the accepted claim.
The theorem gives stationary constraints but does not prove existence or uniqueness of a chaotic invariant measure.
The complete Gao-Ma 2009 article was not securely available for full-text comparison.
A differently phrased stationary balance could remain in unindexed finance-system literature.
title: Stationary investment ceiling and price-adjustment defect in the Huang–Li finance model
